info.title: DigiCrop Lambda APIs
info.description: Consolidated API documentation for the migrated DigiCrop AWS Lambda functions. Each endpoint corresponds to a Lambda function that has been migrated from Node.js to Python.

get.description: Retrieves device telemetry data from the TelemetryData DynamoDB table. If only SerialNumber is provided, returns the latest single record. If SerialNumber, startDate, and endDate are all provided, returns all records within that date range sorted chronologically (ascending).

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description: The serial number of the device. This is the partition key (PK) of the TelemetryData table.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for the date range query. Used with endDate to filter records by the sort key (SK). If omitted (along with endDate), only the latest record is returned.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for the date range query. Used with startDate to filter records by the sort key (SK). If omitted (along with startDate), only the latest record is returned.

200.description: Successfully retrieved telemetry data. Returns a single object (latest record) when only SerialNumber is provided, or an array of objects when startDate and endDate are also provided.

404.description: No data found for the given parameters.

post.description: Uploads Sentinel-2 data to an S3 bucket (sentinel2-all-bands). The data is stored as a JSON file at the key: {dataType_lowercase}/{serialNumber}/{serialNumber}.json. A server-generated UTC ISO 8601 timestamp is added to the stored payload.

requestBody.description: Sentinel-2 data payload to be saved.

400.description: Bad request. Missing required fields in the request body, or invalid JSON.

get.description: Retrieves all Sentinel-2 JSON objects from the S3 bucket for a specific serial number and data type. Lists and reads every object under the S3 prefix: {dataType_lowercase}/{serialNumber}/.

parameters.name: serialNumber
parameters.description: Unique identifier to fetch data for.

parameters.name: dataType
parameters.description: The type of data to fetch (e.g., SENTINEL2).

404.description: No data found for the given criteria.

get.description: Retrieves the latest NDVI historical data for a specific plot from the ndviHistoricalData DynamoDB table. Queries using PK and an SK prefix of PD-{PlotId}, sorted descending (newest first) with a limit of 1 to return only the most recent record. The response payload includes plot metadata, NDVI value (from polygonAverageNDVI), polygon points, pixel grid data, and extracted weather information.

parameters.name: PK
parameters.description: Partition key for the query (typically representing a user or organization ID).

parameters.name: PlotId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the plot. Used to construct the SK prefix PD-{PlotId}.

200.description: Successfully fetched the latest NDVI data.

400.description: Bad request. Missing PK or PlotId.

404.description: No NDVI data found for this plot.

example.message: No NDVI data found for this plot

post.description: Saves plot details to the MainTransactionData DynamoDB table. Generates a UUID for the plot (PlotId) and stores the item with PK set to userId and SK set to PD-{UUID}. The event body is received directly (not wrapped in event.body), so the Lambda reads fields directly from the event object.

requestBody.description: Plot details payload containing crop, location, and farm data.

post.description: Updates soil-related information for an existing plot in the MainTransactionData DynamoDB table. The item is identified by PK=userId and SK=PD-{plotId}. Updates the fields: soil_ph, e_c, organic_carbon, soil_test, and automatically sets updatedAt to the current UTC ISO 8601 timestamp. Returns the fully updated item attributes (ReturnValues=ALL_NEW).

requestBody.description: Soil data update payload. The body may be a JSON string in event.body or a pre-parsed dict.

200.description: Soil data updated successfully. Returns the fully updated DynamoDB item.

post.description: Dynamically updates a plot's information in the MainTransactionData DynamoDB table. The plotId can be provided as a path parameter (priority) or as a query string parameter. The userId is required in the JSON body and is used as the partition key (PK). All other fields in the body (except userId) are treated as dynamic update fields. Uses ConditionExpression attribute_exists(PK) to ensure the item exists before updating. Returns the fully updated item attributes (ReturnValues=ALL_NEW).

parameters.name: plotId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the plot. Forms the sort key as PD-{plotId}. Can alternatively be passed as a query parameter.

requestBody.description: JSON body containing userId (required) and any fields to update. All fields except userId are dynamically applied as update expressions.

400.description: Bad request. Missing required fields or no update fields provided.

get.description: Retrieves historical NDVI and weather time-series data for a plot between a specified start date and end date from the ndviHistoricalData DynamoDB table. Constructs SK range as PD-{PlotId}-{startDate} to PD-{PlotId}-{endDate} and queries with ScanIndexForward=True (ascending order, oldest to newest). The response contains a rich set of fields including plot details, NDVI, current weather, temperature metrics, wind, clouds, rain/precipitation, storms, weather descriptions, sun events, moon events, and timezone.

parameters.name: PK
parameters.description: Partition key (typically a user or organization ID).

parameters.name: PlotId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the plot.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The start date for the time-series range.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date for the time-series range.

400.description: Bad request. One or more required query parameters are missing.

example.message: PK, PlotId, startDate, endDate are required

post.description: Retrieves data from the RawData DynamoDB table based on a SerialNumber and date range. The query behavior depends on the span of the date range: for ranges shorter than 20 days, the Lambda queries using raw Unix-second sort keys (SK BETWEEN startDate AND endDate); for ranges of 20 days or more, the Lambda queries using the DialyAverage- sort-key prefix (SK BETWEEN DialyAverage-startDate AND DialyAverage-endDate). Start dates are set to 00:00:00 and end dates to 23:59:59.999 before converting to Unix seconds. The event fields are read directly from the event object (not from event.body).

requestBody.description: The Lambda reads SerialNumber, startDate, and endDate directly from the event payload.

200.description: Successfully retrieved data. The response body is a JSON string containing an array of DynamoDB items.

body.description: JSON string containing the error object.

post.summary: Store or Update Expo Push Token
post.description: Stores or updates an Expo push notification token in the MainTransactionData DynamoDB table. The Lambda first queries for an existing item with PK=userID and SK beginning with 'ExpoToken'. If an existing record is found, the Token attribute is updated with the new tokenId and the updated attributes are returned. If no existing record is found, a new item is created with PK=userID, SK=ExpoToken-{UUID}, and Token=tokenId. The event fields are read directly from the event object (not from event.body).

requestBody.description: Token storage payload containing the user ID and the Expo push token.

200.description: Token stored or updated successfully. Two possible response shapes exist depending on whether an existing ExpoToken record was found.

oneOf.description: Returned when an existing ExpoToken record is found and updated. The body contains the fully updated DynamoDB item attributes.
Returned when no existing ExpoToken record is found and a new item is created.

500.description: Error updating or creating the token item.

get.description: Retrieves user details from an Amazon Cognito User Pool using the AdminGetUser API. The Lambda reads the username from the event object and returns the user's attributes (UserAttributes array). The Cognito User Pool ID is configured internally in the Lambda and is not exposed as an API parameter.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The Cognito username to look up.

200.description: Successfully retrieved user attributes from Cognito.

500.description: Error retrieving user attributes from Cognito.

TelemetryResponse.description: Telemetry data response. When only SerialNumber is provided, a single object is returned. When startDate and endDate are also provided, an array of objects is returned.

oneOf.description: Single record (latest) when only SerialNumber is queried.
Array of records for the date range.

error.description: Detailed error message from the exception.

serialNumber.description: Unique identifier for the Sentinel-2 data batch.

dataType.description: The type of data being uploaded (e.g., SENTINEL2). Used to construct the S3 key prefix (lowercased).

result.description: The actual data or measurements to store.

key.description: The S3 key where the data was saved.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of when the data was saved.

NDVI.description: The polygon average NDVI value (sourced from the polygonAverageNDVI field in DynamoDB).

NDVIWeather.description: Weather data extracted from the DynamoDB item's weather field.

polygonPoints.description: Optional. Defaults to an empty array [] if omitted.

plotId.description: The generated UUID for the plot.

userId.description: User ID used as the DynamoDB partition key (PK).

plotId.description: Plot ID used to construct the sort key as PD-{plotId}.

soil_test.description: Soil test result (can be boolean or any type).

data.description: The fully updated DynamoDB item attributes (ALL_NEW).

userId.description: User ID used as the DynamoDB partition key (PK). Required but excluded from the update fields.

additionalProperties.description: Any additional fields are treated as dynamic update fields and applied to the DynamoDB item.

data.description: The fully updated DynamoDB item attributes (ALL_NEW).

TimeseriesDataItem.description: A single time-series record containing plot, NDVI, and comprehensive weather data.

SerialNumber.description: Device serial number used as the DynamoDB partition key (PK) in the RawData table.

startDate.description: Start date for the query range. Supports ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY formats.

endDate.description: End date for the query range. Supports the same date formats as startDate.

AverageDataResponse.description: The response wraps the DynamoDB items in a body field as a JSON string.

body.description: A JSON string containing an array of DynamoDB items.

userID.description: The user ID used as the DynamoDB partition key (PK).

tokenId.description: The Expo push notification token to store.

Name.description: The attribute name (e.g., sub, email, email_verified).
